answer: Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
